purpose: Supervisor-requested sensitivity analysis for persistence or recovery in same-recording backgrounds.

comparison.positives: same labeled attack-action windows at every buffer
comparison.cross_negatives: same benign evaluation windows at every buffer
comparison.within_negatives: same attack-recording unlabeled windows outside the exact event-based buffer, via provot_metrics.unlabeled_mask

acceptance_checks.baseline_reproduction: For buffer=300, each of the 80 resolution x modality x seed cells must reproduce revision5/tables/window_sensitivity_summary.csv within 1e-12 for cross_auc, within_auc, delta_cw, n_action, cross_n_neg, and within_n_neg.
acceptance_checks.support_reporting: Report all cells and retained within-negative support. Do not selectively omit low-support cells; mark any cell with fewer than 3 positives or negatives infeasible.
acceptance_checks.scope: The analysis is descriptive sensitivity analysis. It must not claim causal separation of persistence, recovery, operating regime, or recording context.
